summary: Backend /api/tts endpoint verified. Endpoint itself is HEALTHY — the microdemo bypass works, the trial gate is skipped, and ElevenLabs returns real MP3 audio (~29-31 KB) when a valid voice_id is used. ROOT CAUSE of the 'Ollenya doesn't speak' bug: the frontend OllenyaIntroV3.tsx line 739 hardcodes voice_id='vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju', which does NOT exist on the ElevenLabs account tied to ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. ElevenLabs responds 404 voice_not_found; the backend re-raises as HTTP 500 with 'TTS error: status_code: 404, body: ...voice_not_found...'; the frontend playDynamicTTS sees !r.ok, prints a console warning and silently advances without playing audio. All other files in the app use voice_id='POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7' for the Cielo (Ollenya official female) voice — that voice_id works and returns 29,301 bytes of audio/mpeg on both localhost and the public URL.

minor.issue: When ElevenLabs returns 404 voice_not_found, backend re-raises as HTTP 500 with the full upstream error stringified in `detail`. Consider mapping ElevenLabs 404 to a 4xx (e.g. 422 with a structured `{error: 'voice_not_found', voice_id: ...}`) so the client can distinguish 'bad request' from 'server error'. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:11080-11082 (`ElevenLabs TTS error: ...` catch-all).

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded voice_id='vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju' does not exist on the ElevenLabs account. Every /api/tts call from Intro V3 fails with HTTP 500 (upstream 404 voice_not_found) and the audio is silently skipped. Must be replaced with 'POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7' (Cielo — the value used everywhere else in the codebase, e.g. OllenyaIntroConversational.tsx:114, MicroDemoOllenya.tsx:58, app/index.tsx:222, OllenyaIntro.tsx:114). Reference: /app/frontend/components/OllenyaIntroV3.tsx:739

integration_issues.flow: Intro V3 → dynamic TTS ('Posso chiamarti X?')
integration_issues.issue: playDynamicTTS receives HTTP 500 from /api/tts because of the invalid voice_id; the `if (!r.ok)` branch fires and calls onDone() after 400 ms with no audio. To the user this looks like 'Ollenya doesn't speak'.

action_items: FIX (one-liner, frontend): /app/frontend/components/OllenyaIntroV3.tsx line 739 — change `voice_id: "vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju"` to `voice_id: "POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7"` (Cielo). This resolves the 'Ollenya doesn't speak' report.

Consider centralising VOICE_CIELO_ID in a single constant module (e.g. /app/frontend/lib/voices.ts) so future drift is impossible — right now the string 'POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7' is duplicated in 6+ files.

Optional backend hardening: in /app/backend/server.py near line 11080, catch ElevenLabs voice_not_found (404) and re-raise as HTTP 422 with structured detail `{error: 'voice_not_found', voice_id}` instead of a generic 500, so the frontend can surface a meaningful error state.
critical_code_review_comments: Voice IDs are hardcoded string literals scattered across many components (OllenyaIntroV3, OllenyaIntroConversational, MicroDemoOllenya, OllenyaIntro, app/index.tsx). This exact pattern is what caused the reported bug — a typo/drift in one file went unnoticed. Extract to a shared const.

Frontend playDynamicTTS treats any non-2xx from /api/tts as a soft 'skip and advance' with only a console.warn. During onboarding this masks a hard configuration error — consider surfacing a visible state (label / retry) when the primary voice call fails.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_tts_ollenya.py (new — 4 local tests pass, 2 public tests skipped in pytest env but verified manually via curl)
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent flips voice_id in OllenyaIntroV3.tsx:739 to 'POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7', re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_tts_ollenya.py -v` (must stay green) and manually load /intro-v3 to confirm the two dynamic TTS moments ('Posso chiamarti X?' at turn #3) actually play audio. The endpoint itself does not need re-testing — it's healthy.
rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/tts -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"Ciao, io sono Ollenya, e tu?","voice_id":"vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju","tone":"warm","microdemo":true}'` returns HTTP 500 with body `{"detail":"TTS error: status_code: 404, body: {'detail': {'type': 'not_found', 'code': 'voice_not_found', 'message': \"A voice with voice_id 'vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju' was not found.\", 'status': 'voice_not_found', 'request_id': 'bdf1ecdea54cf8b50549b631d6bb3703'}}"}`. Backend log line: `2026-09-16 16:43:36,479 - server - ERROR - ElevenLabs TTS error: status_code: 404, body: {'detail': {'type': 'not_found', 'code': 'voice_not_found', ...}}`. Same call with voice_id='POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7' returns HTTP 200, Content-Type: audio/mpeg, 31,391 bytes (localhost) / 29,301 bytes (public URL). Same call with NO voice_id (falls back to default Acqua '6TngzmzM89jJ3Y2Yiywr') also returns 200 + 31,391 bytes. Trial gate is correctly bypassed by `microdemo:true` — logs show `[tts] microdemo=true → forcing model=eleven_turbo_v2_5`. MITIGATION: change the one voice_id string in /app/frontend/components/OllenyaIntroV3.tsx:739 from 'vTgTi6iSjMPqDpAcJfju' to 'POuqf18evoXOKIqV2Px7'.
